image_description: A group of people dancing around a tall wooden maypole in a grassy park setting. The pole is topped with a decorative wreath/finial and features numerous long, colorful ribbons (streamers) extending to the ground, held by the dancers. The scene captures a traditional May Day celebration.

The connection points between the dancers' hands and the ribbons are indistinct. In several cases, the ribbon seems to fade into the hand or sleeve rather than being clearly gripped, suggesting minor generation artifacts in complex interaction zones.
Slight warping in the vertical lines of the background trees and fence on the right side, typical of AI-generated backgrounds, though not structurally catastrophic.
